helltideRegions.note: Community guides (2026) list Helltide zones in all seven regions, and Blizzard's 3.3.0 PTR notes speak of Helltides in expansion zones. Blizzard has not published a per-region list.

legionSites.name: Kor Dragan
legionSites.note: In the northwest of the region.

legionSites.name: Carrowcrest Ruins
legionSites.note: Also spelled Carrownest Ruins in one guide.

legionSites.name: Crusader's Monument
legionSites.note: Spelled Crusader's Monument in the guides; one tracker writes Crusaders Monument.

legionSites.name: Chakhir
legionSites.note: An expansion Legion inside the Chakhir Stronghold, which a party must have conquered. Runs alongside the base-game Legion.

legionSites.name: Basin of Souls
legionSites.note: Nahantu's Legion is an escort: an orb is guarded on its way to the Basin of Souls and back.

chestTypes.name: Tortured Gift of Mysteries
chestTypes.note: The orange "?" chest: 250 Aberrant Cinders in Torment, 75 below it. Players in 2026 report two per Helltide, one in each part of it, moving to another spot about half an hour in (community reports, not documented by Blizzard), so a mark lasts until then.

chestTypes.name: Hell's Prize
chestTypes.note: The "!" chest from the Lord of Hatred War Plans Helltide node: 666 Aberrant Cinders. Shown on the map only with that node chosen; how often it appears is unclear.

chestTypes.name: Other Tortured Gift (armor, jewelry, weapons)
chestTypes.note: The Torment gifts named for what they drop (for example Tortured Gift of Amulets), 75 to 150 Aberrant Cinders. Players report chests moving about half an hour in.

blizzard-1.2.0-waypoints.title: Diablo IV patch 1.2.0 notes (2023-10-17), waypoints unlocked for characters that skip the campaign
blizzard-1.2.0-waypoints.quote: Dry Steppes: Chambatar Ridge and Untamed Scraps. Fractured Peaks: Bear Tribe Refuge and Yelesna. Hawezar: Backwater and Ruins of Rakhat Keep: Inner Court. Kehjistan: Caldeum and Tarsarak. Scosglen: Marrowen and Tirmair.
